$description: Reclaim AI public marketing site (reclaim.ai) and the signed-out login at app.reclaim.ai/login, measured 2026-11-19 from live computed styles. Marketing custom properties use Webflow names (--_brand-colors-2026---*, --_apps---*). The login page resolves a separate --rai-* set on a dark login background. Dark app tokens are declared on the marketing stylesheets and on the login page; the signed-in app was not opened, so dark is a declared palette, not a captured surface.

display.$description: Marketing h2 and pricing display. The homepage h1 uses Sharp Grotesk DB Book 23 at the same role.
